subject: general
question: A dealer lists his goods at 40% above cost price and allows a discount of 20%. His profit is:
solution:
Given:

A dealer lists his goods at 40% above the cost price and allows a discount of 20%.

Concept used:

Successive percentage change of A% and B%, results into = (A + B + {(A times B) over 100})\%

Calculation:

Profit percentage = 40 - 20 - {(40 times 20) over 100} = 12%

(Here discount is considered as a negative percentage change)

∴ His profit is 12%.
